title: pose.state data (server to client), at most movenet.publish_hz (R2-G)

model.description: Name of the pose model that produced the keypoints.

width.description: Width of the frame the keypoints refer to, in pixels.

fps.description: Processed frames per second, or null.

dpu_ms.description: Last MoveNet inference on the DPU, or null.

total_ms.description: Last whole-chain time of the frame, or null.

score.description: Mean keypoint score: below 0.2 when nobody is in the frame and the keypoints may be stale.

keypoints.description: COCO-17 order: nose, left_eye, right_eye, left_ear, right_ear, left_shoulder, right_shoulder, left_elbow, right_elbow, left_wrist, right_wrist, left_hip, right_hip, left_knee, right_knee, left_ankle, right_ankle.
